release_0_6_7_delta: TEST DISCOVERY REBUILT SO THE TWO SILENT UNDER-REPORTS CANNOT RECUR IN ANY REPOSITORY SHAPE. The owner's standard, and the right one: a defect of this class must never exist regardless of how the user's repository is structured. Both misses had one root - a hardcoded list of conventions, incomplete, and incomplete QUIETLY. Under-reporting sends a run to a weaker oracle than it had and, unlike over-reporting, leaves nothing behind to notice. A longer list is not the fix, because conventions cannot be enumerated in advance. THREE LAYERS instead. (1) READ WHAT THE REPOSITORY DECLARES. Test patterns are configuration, not folklore: jest/vitest testMatch and include, playwright testMatch and testDir, pytest python_files and testpaths, mocha spec, across 20 config files. This is rank-3 `host` provenance turned on the detector itself - a repository that has already said what its tests are should never be guessed at. On a real repository this read playwright.config.ts and the evidence line now says so. Three defects were found inside this layer while building it, each one a parser that believed it had succeeded: package.json keys are QUOTED, so a pattern demanding a colon straight after the word matched nothing in the commonest place a repo declares this; array capture stopped at the FIRST `]`, cutting `**/?(*.)+(weird).[jt]s` down to a pattern matching nothing, because character classes are idiomatic inside these globs; and jest extglob (`?(...)`, `+(...)`) is not fnmatch, so each group is now loosened to `*`, which over-matches slightly and never under-matches. (2) BUILT-IN SHAPES, BROADENED, plus a directory rule: a file under test/ tests/ __tests__/ spec/ e2e/ is test material even when its name follows no convention (`e2e/login.ts`). Matching is by TOKEN, never substring - the substring version flagged `latest-brief.ts` and `spec_synthesis.py` and produced 466 near misses on one repository, and a near-miss list that long is the same as none. `it` was dropped as a token: it is the Italian language code and flagged `locales/it.d.ts`. (3) NEAR MISSES ARE PRINTED, NOT FILED. Anything test-adjacent that matched nothing is counted and named in the report. This is the promise that can actually be kept: not 'no convention is ever missed' but 'nothing is missed quietly'. It earns its place immediately - on an Airflow repository it surfaced `archive/clients/test.py`, a shape no built-in covers. MONOREPO: nested package manifests no longer exclude anything; only a nested `.git` does. VERIFIED ON FOUR STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT REPOSITORIES, counts cross-checked against git rather than asserted: a 4,925-commit JS monorepo with playwright (668, exact match against an independent count, zero difference in either direction), this repo (11, where a naive git grep said 9 and was WRONG twice - it missed a file living in tests/ and wrongly excluded test_fixture_admission.py by filename), a React app (4), an Airflow repo (156). Three times today the yardstick was the broken thing and the tool was right; trusting the yardstick would have introduced the defect it was meant to catch. Tests: awbp/tests/test_test_discovery.py, 40 cases across ecosystems, declarations, monorepos, submodules and near-miss reporting. Runtime on the 213 MB repository is about a second. Zero provider calls.
release_0_6_6_delta: END-TO-END ON A REPOSITORY THE TOOL HAD NEVER SEEN, plus the MCP surface. The environment was pointed at a 213 MB, 4,925-commit open-source repository with 4,401 tracked files, a clean tree, and 561 test suites, and every command in the README was EXECUTED against it rather than proofread. The repository was returned bit-identical afterwards. Eight defects surfaced, all in this environment, none in the repository being examined. (1) MONOREPO BLINDNESS, the worst of them. The nested-workspace rule excluded any directory holding a package manifest, on the reasoning that a project root below the repo root means a vendored copy. Every package in a monorepo has one, so ten first-party suites were dropped silently, by reporting a smaller number. `.git` is now the only nested-repository signal kept, because it is the only one that means what it says. The known limit is stated in the test rather than hidden: a vendored copy with a manifest, no .git and an unconventional directory name is counted, and excluding it would cost every monorepo its real suites. (2) `*.spec.ts` MATCHED NO GLOB AT ALL, hiding an entire end-to-end directory. Seven overlapping globs replaced by one walk and one regular expression covering every test shape in the ecosystems this has been pointed at. (3) THE WALK NOW ASKS GIT FIRST. `git ls-files` is the authoritative answer to what a repository's own material is; every version that guessed got the number wrong in BOTH directions on the same repository within one hour (49, then 651 against 89 tracked, before the real answer turned out to be 651 and the 89 turned out to be a bad yardstick of mine). (4) A TEST FILE OFFERED AS DESIGN CONVENTIONS: `e2e/theme-toggle.spec.ts` matched a startswith('theme') probe. Host candidates now exclude anything the test matcher recognises. (5) `awbp init` SAID 'Ready' ON A REPOSITORY WHOSE OWN SUITE IS RED. Exit status followed whether a test command had been FOUND, not whether the oracle is usable. It now reports NOT READY, names the consequence, and exits non-zero; `--no-verify` gets its own wording because nothing has shown the suite passes. The 561-path command is truncated for display: a stranger's first command used to bury the one line that mattered under a screenful of file paths. (6) RUNNING SOMEBODY'S SUITE IS NOT A READ. The baseline run triggered a code-generation step that rewrote four tracked files, and nothing said so. `init` now diffs the working tree across the run and names every file the suite touched, stating plainly that awbp did not write them. (7) A SILENT CAPABILITY LOSS WITH A MISLEADING SEQUEL. 78.7 MB of tracked source exceeded a 50 MB snapshot cap, so the pre-change tree was skipped; `task` printed 'Prepared', and `probe` then told somebody who had just run `awbp task` to run `awbp task`. The cap is raised to 512 MB (50 MB is not a large repository in 2026; a cap that fires on ordinary work is a capability that switches itself off), `--max-baseline-bytes` overrides it, the skip is announced with the numbers and what it costs, and the downstream error states the real reason. (8) `awbp probe` REPORTED EARNED ON AN EMPTY DIFF, because `earned = not uncovered` is vacuously true when there is nothing to probe. This environment's own headline defect, in this environment's own tool, on the exact path the README sends a stranger down. It now refuses. MCP SERVER (awbp/mcp_server.py, new; `python -m awbp mcp`). JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, implemented directly, standard library only: a tool whose argument is 'your green is worth what its oracle is worth' cannot ask for a dependency tree before saying so. Five READ-ONLY tools - oracle_plan, host_rules, check_calibration, coverage_manifest, demo - and the read-only claim is asserted, not promised: tests/test_mcp_server.py fingerprints a repository before and after every tool runs against it. The write commands stay in the CLI so an agent reaching through a socket cannot snapshot a workspace as a side effect of asking a question. Its first version documented field names that did not match the API, which produced a beautifully formatted report saying nothing was covered: a confident wrong answer rather than an error. Aliases are now normalised, because a caller on the far side of a socket cannot read the source to find out. The flagship report also printed bare dimension ids where no statement was supplied, telling the reader that something was uncovered while withholding what; it now says so. NAMED: the project is EARNED GREEN. `awbp` remains the command. The directory is unchanged so nothing that points at it breaks. RUNNING TALLY: 28 instrument defects across this programme, none in the work being graded. Tests: 46 MCP cases, 27 demo, 32 ledger/host, 14 ownership, plus the existing calibration suite. Zero provider calls.
release_0_6_5_delta: THE LAST TWO PATTERNS FROM THE 2026-07-21 CLIENT INSTRUMENT ARE NOW REPO-AGNOSTIC, and the detector that routes to them was corrected four times under a test suite it never had. (1) fact_ledger.py, provenance `data`, rank 4. Every asserted fact is the RETURN VALUE OF A QUERY registered beside it; a fact with no source string is refused at registration, because a number without its query is provenance `spec` wearing a data costume. The audit runs BACKWARDS, which is the whole point: instead of checking that the ledger's facts appear in the output, it takes every number the output asserts and asks which derivation produced it. An unledgered number was typed in by whoever wrote the document, which on the source campaign happened four times. Two further refusals are enforced rather than documented: a derivation returning empty/zero/None is reported FAILED, never as the value zero (a store the run could not reach answers exactly like a store that is genuinely empty), and when more than one layer is registered every fact must name its layer (the worst error of that day was reading one store, finding a small number, and reporting it as the size of the estate). (2) host_rules.py, provenance `host`, rank 3. Mechanical extraction of house conventions from the files the product already renders from, with four format-shaped extractors that travel: js_exports (string-aware balanced-literal reader, so a brace inside a quoted tagline no longer truncates the rule set), json_tokens, css_variables, directives. On the source campaign this was the ONLY mechanically-measurable difference between two arms producing the same document. Extraction of ZERO rules from a file that exists is reported `usable: false`, never as an empty rule set, because a document checked against no rules passes all of them. (3) oracle_plan.py ownership, four corrections, now under tests/test_oracle_plan_ownership.py. The first three fixes were name lists; this one is a rule: a path is not this repo's own source if any directory between the root and it holds a project manifest (nested workspace), or if any DIRECTORY segment is named for fixtures (test inputs in every ecosystem that has the convention, and here also deliberately-broken copies of other repos whose PASSING tests would be the most misleading rank-4 oracle this tool could offer). The fourth defect was found by the new test and ran the opposite way: overlapping test globs summed their matches, so the evidence line reported 51 suites where 27 exist, and the root-only glob had previously reported this repo WEAK while its own suites sat at tools/<area>/tests/. Under-reporting sends a run to a weaker oracle than it had, which is the same failure as over-reporting with the sign flipped. COUNT FOR THE RECORD: five defects found in instruments during this release, none in the work they grade. The fact ledger's own demo was written to fail and passed, because a trailing lookahead made a sentence-final number invisible to the scanner; that is how the first one surfaced.
release_0_6_4_delta: THE ENVIRONMENT NOW ASKS THREE QUESTIONS IT NEVER ASKED, all at task start, and REFUSES a verdict when the answers are missing. (1) WHERE DOES THE ORACLE COME FROM (oracle_plan.py, new; asked BEFORE the mode). It detects which oracle sources this repo can actually supply and ranks them by the measured ladder: diff-derived/data/repo-tests (4) > host/relation/acceptance (3) > spec (2) > authored/council (1). A spec-only repo is reported WEAK with the reason stated, because a green from a spec-only instrument means the work agrees with its own description. Two detector defects were found and fixed by reading its evidence rather than its verdict: it offered `node_modules/.pnpm/core-js/...test.js` as 'the repo's own tests' on a JS project, and on THIS repo it offered migrations and tests living inside benchmark run artifacts, which are copies of a different repo's workspace. A detector that counts vendored or generated files hands out a rank-4 oracle that does not exist. On VextrumFrontend it now correctly points at src/components/brand/ as the rank-3 source, which is exactly the file whose non-use decided a campaign comparison earlier the same day. (2) WHO DOES THE WORK AND WHO CHECKS IT (execution_strategy.py, new; wired into `awbp task --strategy/--reason/--risk`). Three strategies, each carrying its own measurement history rather than a recommendation: `solo` (executor only), `reviewed` (cheap executor + strong adversarial reviewer), `council` (strong executor + reviewer + independent council). The measured basis, one task and one trial per arm on a real client deliverable: the reviewed arm produced the best-formatted document at 52% of the uniform-expensive cost AND dropped three of four checkable figures, so there is no winner and a default would be a guess dressed as a policy. NOT default-off and NOT default-on: DECLARED, with a reason of at least eight words that must refer to this task ('seemed fine' is refused). The declaration is provenance `authored` and says so in its own record: it is kept so the choice can later be CORRELATED with the outcome, not because choosing is worth anything by itself. Strategies name capability PROFILES, never model names, so they cannot rot when the catalogue changes. (3) MODEL RESOLUTION, the one broken link (prepare_context.py). The chain task -> mode -> profile -> model existed in full: adaptive_router chose the profiles, prepare_context wrote them into the pack, pre_submit_gate enforced their presence, and NOTHING ever resolved a profile to a model. One function call. A pack now carries concrete selectors (lite/low -> haiku, standard/medium -> sonnet, critical/critical -> opus + opus reviewer) and failure is soft and loud: an expired catalogue or an unsatisfiable profile disables automation and records why instead of guessing a model name. CALIBRATION IS NOW BLOCKING (pre_submit_gate). When a task registers a known-good/known-hollow fixture pair and the instrument cannot separate them, completion is REFUSED, not weakened: a score from an uncalibrated instrument is not a weak score, it is not a score. A task that registered no pair is NAMED as such rather than assumed fine. INSTRUMENT HYGIENE (instrument_hygiene.py, new): `selftest` requires every predicate to carry an example it MUST match, and `evaluate` refuses to grade at all while any rule is dead; `Fingerprint` gives before/after read-only evidence with two lessons built in, that a continuously-ingesting counter needs a tolerance and an inspection rather than an equality test, and that evidence is WRITE-ONCE. WHY ANY OF THIS: on 2026-07-21 a single day produced THIRTEEN defects in instruments and ZERO in the work they graded. Three produced entirely plausible numbers. One predicate had its word boundaries written into the source as literal backspace bytes and could therefore never fire, reporting PASS for its whole life. A grader flagged an honest client document six times, every time for quoting a false claim in order to refute it, or for being more current than the ground truth it was checked against. That ratio, thirteen to zero, is the most consistent finding in this programme, and it is what these mechanisms are for. NOT DONE, stated so it is not read as complete: the cost router is WIRED but UNMEASURED (n=1), the strategy declaration has no outcome correlation yet because nothing has been correlated, the tiered loop and support council remain candidate-only, and two of the four Delta Global tools generalised here are patterns whose queries are necessarily per-repo (the data-fact ledger and the host-rule extractor; reference implementations live in workstreams/delta-global-alt-data-package/instrument/). Tests: 15 promoted + 43 candidate, green; 28 Stable modules import clean. Zero provider calls for this release.
release_0_6_3_delta: SIX REPO-AGNOSTIC MECHANISMS, earned by family-4 (idea-tracker, the first from-scratch regime measured) and by the production build that followed it. WHAT CLASS THESE ARE, stated up front because it decides how much they are worth: none of them tries to change what the model does. They change WHAT GETS REPORTED and WHEN WE REFUSE TO GRADE. That is deliberate — the three mechanisms this programme measured at exactly zero (mode ladders, agent-authored check ceremonies, notes-as-code) all tried to change model behaviour. These cannot improve an output; they can only stop us announcing a green we did not earn. They are therefore promoted WITHOUT a correctness-lift claim, and none is implied. (1) PROVENANCE RANK + ORACLE INDEPENDENCE (coverage_manifest.PROVENANCE_RANK, .independence): sources ranked by distance from the agent — diff-derived/data/repo-tests=4, host/relation/acceptance/finding=3, spec=2, authored/council=1, model-review=0 — with the independence floor set ABOVE spec. Two new provenances: 'data' (a number recomputed from the system's own data) and 'host' (extracted mechanically from the host codebase). The ordering is the measured one: diff-derived + forcing loop carried both positive families (88.7 vs 33.3, 71.3 vs 43.0); agent-authored gate-admitted checks measured ZERO lift (9 runs, all 92); spec-derived SATURATED on family-4 (both arms near-perfect while the owner's eye found four defects none of them saw). (2) THE REPORT OPENS WITH THE GAP (coverage_manifest.render): first line is 'NOT MECHANICALLY COVERED — N behaviour(s) you asked for', by name, then the independence percentage, then green. Earned the hard way: on family-4 a viewport-overflow predicate was written, was CORRECTLY rejected as vacuous, and its dimension CORRECTLY landed in the unverified column — the machinery worked perfectly and nobody read it, because the summary opened with green; the owner found that exact defect by eye minutes later. (3) CALIBRATION AS A PRECONDITION OF GRADING (calibration_gate.py, new): before grading anything, re-grade the known-good and known-hollow fixtures through the SAME path; if the instrument cannot separate them, REFUSE TO GRADE. Earned by five instrument defects in one day, three of which produced plausible numbers: playwright's last-registered-first route resolution shadowing the API stubs (the whole 65->86 swing), an unset VITE_API_BASE_URL that would have scored every arm a believable zero, a shell rewriting /api into a Windows path inside the build env, and TWO successive layout predicates that came back green on a build with a visible clipping defect. Documented limit: under the default bands (good>=0.70, hollow<=0.40) the min-separation check cannot fire, and says so — a check that can never fire under its own defaults reads like a guarantee and is not one. (4) STATE_LIVES_IN (awbp task --state-lives-in): one field, asked at task START — where does user-visible state live in production, and who else can see it? 'browser-only (demo)' is a valid answer that must be CHOSEN. Earned by a spec line ('local-first is fine and expected') that was correct as scope and produced a polished TEAM board storing the team's ideas in one person's browser; nobody noticed until the owner asked whether it worked in production. (5) BOOKKEEPING DEFECTS NOW FAIL THE GATE (pre_submit_gate): coverage_manifest.build raises ValueError only on a duplicate dimension id or an id-less check; the gate used to swallow that into an informational 'unavailable' field, so the manifest vanished from the report exactly when it had found something. It is now a gate failure. (6) HARNESS-AUTHORING RULES (candidate doc, not code — unenforceable by construction): a stand-in that returns live references or lets framework-injected defaults arrive unresolved INVENTS failures (both happened: a live row let a route read its own pre-update snapshot, reporting 'Moved exploring -> exploring'; an unresolved FastAPI Query(False) silently disabled a filter); a false failure should be checked for what it points at before dismissal (the first one pointed at genuine fragility, since hardened); and a predicate that has not been RED on something broken is worth zero (proved twice in one hour on the same defect). RODE ALONG with coverage_manifest, named rather than smuggled: the tiered package's provenance vocabulary (spec/council/acceptance/finding), the NON_CERTIFYING 'reviewed-unverified' provenance (a model's review never moves a dimension into the verified column — judges report 0.72-0.94 pass at 0.20 true accuracy), and the duplicate-id/dangling-claim hard failures from the Fable audit. All are the same class (reporting/refusal, never model behaviour) and all are test-covered. NOT PROMOTED and still candidate-only: the tiered loop, the support council (council_enabled stays FALSE — an unmeasured mechanism does not ship enabled), oracle_bootstrap and its new red-on-hollow admission route, and the web-UI layout predicates (host-specific by construction — they belong in a pack, not the core). Tests: tools/adaptive/tests/test_independence_and_calibration.py, 15 cases, each named after the thing that actually went wrong; the candidate package's 43-case suite remains green. Zero provider calls. Full trail: workstreams/idea-tracker/LESSONS-for-the-environment.md and Research/candidate-packages/2026-07-21-family4-instrument-lessons/.
release_0_6_2_delta: THE DECISIVE VERDICT, measured under pre-registered falsification conditions (evidence decisive-campaign-{predictions,observed}.json): on a hard, wide, underspecified rework (vextrum-era-v3-gen4, admitted PASS, before=17/after=100/alt=100) the FULL ENVIRONMENT — verification loop iterating against a frozen suite of 30 gen-4 diff-derived relational predicates — beat WELL-CONFIGURED VANILLA 88.7 vs 33.3 mean over 3 valid trials per arm, non-overlapping distributions (worst loop trial 83 > best configured 50), with the loop demonstrably iterating (red-to-green at iteration 2 in one trial) and the universally-neglected dimensions (citation hygiene, block citations) going green ONLY under forcing. The measured RECIPE, each ingredient necessary: hard task (easy ones saturate: hermes-etl all-100) + VALID instrument (gen-3 exact projections zeroed real work; gen-4 relational rewards partial work without pinning) + loop with frozen mechanical predicates (without it the neglected dimensions stay at zero). SCOPE, registered before the first call: replay paradigm (predicates derive from history via oracle_cli derive - available where history provides a before/after; guards remain the everywhere-deployable layer); one task family so far; ~2.5x token cost; the silent-defect-rate envelope advantage was NOT differentiated on this task (0.0 both arms) and stands on the medi-ny measurement alone. This claim REFINES, not replaces, the 0.6.0 three-regime map: regime-3 wide reworks are now conquerable when a valid relational instrument exists and a loop enforces it. SCOPE UPDATE 2026-07-20 (pre-registered rule executed): a replication attempt on a second, fully disjoint family (vextrum-dataflow-era-v1, 13 owner-approved calls) came back UNMEASURED - every arm flat at 43 because the recording stub served rows in the reference's column aliases and pinned the fix-invented watermark schema (the over-constraint class one layer down, invisible to the before/after/alt admission trio). The decisive claim therefore stands on ONE family. FAMILY-2 FINAL (2026-07-20, 27 calls across three instrument generations, all pre-registered): after the instrument was made valid (v2.3 - alias projection, RETURNING/rowcount semantics, operator-agnostic comparisons, reference-quirk policy; admitted PASS), a fresh bare-vanilla canary scored 100 and the registered saturation brake stopped the campaign - the family sits inside variance-dominated one-shot competence, so it CANNOT host a forcing-value verdict (the hermes-etl lesson at four-module scale). Verdict: family 2 is UNTESTABLE-AS-HARD; the decisive claim remains scoped to family 1; difficulty - not instrument validity and not loop capability - is the scarce ingredient. The exploratory consistency signal (loop 3/3 convention-complete vs configured 1/3 on the prior campaign's workspaces under the final instrument) is on record as suggestive, not a verdict. Full trail: evidence/dataflow-replication-observed.json, dataflow2-replication-observed.json, dataflow3-verdict-observed.json. FAMILY-3 REPLICATION CONFIRMED (2026-07-20, 13 pre-registered calls on portal-insights-era-v1 - third repo, API-analytics domain, instrument admitted PASS on its FIRST build because every family-2 lesson was designed in): oracle-loop mean 71.3 vs well-configured vanilla 43.0 over 3 valid trials per arm, gap 28.3 > the 16-pt band (P-3V1 pre-committed rule). The recipe's forcing-value claim now stands on TWO measured-hard families; the consistency pattern is the sharpest regularity across all campaigns: the loop's floor equals the bare-canary level while unforced arms fall below it (configured 29/29 vs bare 57 here). Difficulty gates remain essential: the gray-zone difficulty canary (57) was resolved by explicit owner decision, recorded. Evidence: portal-family3-{predictions,observed}.json.
release_0_6_1_delta: GEN-4 RELATIONAL PREDICATES in tools/adaptive/{diff_oracle.py,oracle_cli.py} (oracle_cli derive --relational): kinds-superset (kinds the reference GAINED must be a subset of the solution's) and per-kind count-direction (became-nonzero/became-zero/increased/decreased vs before). These are the measured valid mid-levels for regime (3): partial credit that still separates, red-on-before structural, valid-variant filter unchanged. Exploratory validation on the era material confirmed all 5 pre-registered predictions and mechanically RECOVERED one dimension the gen-3 exact instrument had to drop as ungradeable; text-semantic dimensions without a countable observable remain NAMED unverified — gen-4 narrows regime (3)'s boundary, does not close it. notes: Only the minimal Core is stable. Release 0.6.0 is THE HONEST MAP: it retracts every claim that scaffolding, verification loops, check authoring, notes or admission gates improve CORRECTNESS OF NEW BEHAVIOUR for frontier models on in-context tasks (measured null on two independent task families, replicated at every intervention level, including a loop carrying PERFECT mechanical predicates on a saturated task; prose instruction measured inert). What Stable claims instead is measured, three regimes: (1) REGRESSION PROTECTION - mechanical and deployable: before-state differentials + envelope guards (oracle_cli guards) mined from the current code; silent_defect_rate 0.0 vs 0.25 on the real medi-ny campaign; envelope pins green on 11/11 real implementations; over-constraint structurally impossible because the envelope is measured then pinned. (2) NARROW BEHAVIOURAL CHANGES - diff-derived predicates from git history (oracle_cli derive) are near-perfect oracles: 9/9 defective solutions red, reference and a valid variant green, zero model calls, on the exact material three generations of mind-derived predicates missed; the valid-variant filter kills format-pinning (40 of 70 candidates on first use). (3) WIDE UNDERSPECIFIED REWORKS - no single-reference mechanical oracle is valid (measured on a real 4-commit era: agents' genuine work graded zero by exact projections; text dimensions have no generic abstraction between changed and verbatim); such dimensions are NAMED as unverified by the coverage manifest and routed to per-rule predicates or human acceptance - green never quietly claims them. USER STORY: a person who clones this repo points oracle_cli at THEIR repo and writes only a few-line capture (Setup/oracle-guide.md); proven by a gate test that builds a foreign repo from scratch and walks the whole path through the CLI. Also promoted: coverage manifest in the pre-submit gate (typed verdict: EARNED GREEN per named dimension with provenance + NAMED unverified; informational in 0.6.0), commit_miner (ranks history's replay-worthy fixes; self-validated by surfacing the commit our own fixture was hand-built from), notes bank with earned persistence (PROCESS memory only - measured: style transfers, predicate strength does not; its retirement rule fired live), the harness derived check kind (self-describing pins, zero authoring calls), and the node/JS hardening of check admission and authoring (ERR_ASSERTION vocabulary, whole-checks-subtree collection, pristine-workspace baselines). 0.5.0 earned-green mechanics and 0.4.0 loop architecture unchanged and still authoritative. Every claim above has a pre-registered predictions file and an evidence file beside it in the candidate package (see PROMOTION-0.6.0-honest-map.md for the index).
